rationale: Current best only reaches about 773 of 20000 nominal iterations, so the staged tail recurrence ramp stays at the minimum gain while final evaluation uses full recurrence. This self-contained script embeds the current best plus a compact schedule horizon: TAIL_RECUR_SCHEDULE_STEPS defaults to 1200, making the first recurrent tail block ramp to full strength during the late quant-aware phase without changing shapes, validation, export, or metric print formats.
title: Wallclock-Horizon Tail Recurrence Ramp
